limits: Bounded Linux/toolchain experiments; no physical target claim.
A successful reference run does not establish independent learner performance.
Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
Strict C17 core implements logical widths1..16 and imports actual prior integer cell codec. Independent bit-list oracle covers all8-bit values and all4-bit simultaneous/sequential edit combinations.
Actual native objects and four direct-linked M4 images audited; five explicit objects and no libc/libgcc/compiler-rt/libatomic archive. Original helpers explicitly named.
Actual packing/bit-field layout and shared plugins are Linux x86-64 ABI observations. The wire descriptor is separately encoded; plugin version cannot prove foreign code safety or a different ABI.
Teaching register W1C/RTC is an original explicit state machine; no actual MMIO, device behavior, barriers or physical timing claim.
Intrinsic capability/zero wrapper is a separate comparison; unsafe overlays/clz(0)/shift examples compile-only.
External review, independent learner, seven-day transfer and physical evidence remain absent. Finite checks do not prove absolute mastery.
